title: Evaluation issue disposition
description: Auditable disposition of implementation work and the evaluation registered for an issue.

kind.description: Versioned contract discriminator for the disposition record.

issue_ref.description: Repository issue whose implementation and evaluation outcomes are reconciled.

evaluation_id.description: Stable identifier of the continuing evaluation registration.

status.description: Current relationship between issue implementation and its evaluation.

implementation_disposition.description: Evidence-backed disposition of the issue's implementation requirements.

evaluation_disposition.description: Registration, ownership, and lifecycle details for the evaluation.

future_evidence_audit.description: Checks that future evidence must satisfy before changing the disposition.
